name: Motorized Bicycle
description: A bicycle with an automatic transmission and a motor that displaces no more than 50 cc. A bicycle that meets Arkansas's electric bicycle definition is excluded, but the statute sets no electric power or speed limit for one that doesn't. Defined by Arkansas Code §27-20-101(3) and regulated by §27-20-111.
restrictions: A bicycle with an automatic transmission and a motor displacing no more than 50 cc; the statute gives no electric equivalent of that limit
An electric bicycle under §27-51-1702 (under 750 W, with fully operable pedals, in Class 1, 2 or 3) is excluded; an electric-motored bicycle outside that definition isn't covered by the exclusion

Riders need a motorized bicycle certificate from the Arkansas State Police, earned by passing a rules-of-the-road exam, a vision test and a road test; a motorcycle, motor-driven cycle or Class A, B, C or D license qualifies instead
No certificate is issued to anyone under 14, and a rider under 14 can't ride one in a city of 10,000 or more
A rider under 16 can't carry a passenger
Riders and passengers under 21 must wear protective headgear, and every rider and passenger must wear protective glasses, goggles or a transparent face shield
Needs a headlight, a rear red reflector and red tail lamp, brakes, a horn, a muffler and electric turn signals
Barred from interstate highways, limited-access highways and sidewalks; otherwise follows all state and local traffic laws
None of these rules apply when ridden on a farm or on private property
